review:
Roadkill is a 5x3 cartoon slot about woodland animals fighting back. Two scatters start Call to Arms with two hearts, and a third during that mode leads to Team Assemble free spins.

Jumping Wild animals such as Papa Bear move around the battle area on reels 2 to 4 between rounds, each with a matching collector. xSplit also appears. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with an 11,091x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
